# FG Digital Systems

## About
FG Digital Systems is a growth partner for small and medium-sized businesses (Pymes) in Spain and Italy. Founded by Francesco Gentile, we specialize in creating high-performance web systems that attract customers and automate sales. We focus on transparency, speed, and real results without monthly fees or complex technical jargon.

## Services and Pricing
- **Pack 1 — Empieza Bien**: Single-page web, mobile-first, WhatsApp/call buttons. Delivery in 3-5 days.
- **Pack 2 — Consigue Clientes**: Up to 5 pages, conversion-focused copy, Google Business Profile optimization. Delivery in 5-10 days. (Most popular)
- **Pack 3 — Empieza a Competir**: SEO Local structure, keyword research, 3 blog articles, strategic roadmap. Delivery in 10-20 days.
- **Pack 4 — Full Sales System**: Full automation (n8n/Make/Zapier), Stripe integration, CRM sync, automated booking. Delivery in 2-4 weeks.
- **Retainers**: Monthly SEO and maintenance plans (Starter, Standard, Authority) for continuous growth.
- **Add-ons**: Extra pages, Google Business Profile setup, Tally forms, booking buttons, and AI chatbots.

## Locations

## What Makes Us Different
Unlike traditional agencies that focus on "branding" or "holistic transformation" for months, FG Digital Systems delivers functional sales systems in as little as 10 days. We prioritize conversion over aesthetics alone, ensuring that every website is a tool for generating leads and revenue.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Why are your prices public?
A: We believe in transparency. Local businesses value knowing their investment from the start.

Q: Will I own the website?
A: Yes, 100%. No lock-in contracts. You can take your website with you if you ever decide to leave.

Q: Do you guarantee the #1 spot on Google?
A: No honest agency can. We guarantee clean technical SEO, ultra-fast loading, and a realistic data-driven strategy.

Q: How long does SEO take to show results?
A: Initial movements are seen in 4-8 weeks. Solid, stable results typically take 3-6 months.
